description: Predictive failure analysis for ONE agent, computed on request from its last 7 days of calls against a 30-day baseline: error-rate breaches, latency degradation, cost overruns and traffic anomalies, each with severity, confidence, trend and recommended actions. Needs at least 20 calls in the last 7 days — below that it returns no predictions, which means too little data, not a healthy agent. Do NOT use for current/past failures — use get_alerts for active issues. Requires an API key with the 'read' scope.

severity.description: Only show predictions of this severity

name: metrx_get_failure_predictions
title: Get Failure Predictions
